portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
The evolution package includes a mailer, calendar, contact manager and
communication facility.  The tools that make up Evolution are tightly
integrated with one another and act as a seamless personal
information-management tool.

This update resolves the following bugs:

- Upgrading Evolution from version 1.4 (or earlier) to version 2.0 caused
Evolution to miscalculate disk space requirements and exit on file systems
larger than 2 terrabytes.  

 - A problem was discovered in Evolution's mail component.  Evolution was
unable to display the content of certain HTML email messages. If the
preview window was unsuccessful in displaying one of these messages, it
would be unable to display any further messages until Evolution was restarted.

 - Evolution's help documentation has been updated.

 - A problem was discovered in Evolution's calendar synchronization code. 
If the user enabled Evolution's ECalendar conduit for gnome-pilot,
configured it to "Split multi-day events", and attempted to synchronize an
"All Day Event" lasting multiple days, Evolution would exit.
 
- A problem was discovered with the authentication code in Evolution's NNTP
backend.  Evolution could report a "Cannot retrieve newsgroups" error when
the user attempted to connect to certain news servers.

Users of evolution should upgrade to these updated packages, which resolve
these issues.
